property_summary: For any caller A, when A (as msg.sender) calls setOwner(B), the reference contract sets owner to B (owner == B); the mutant that uses tx.origin can be made to differ by having a contract forward the call so tx.origin != msg.sender, causing owner != B for some inputs.
change_summary: Change the require to compare tx.origin to owner, restricting only direct-origin callers (potentially different callers) instead of msg.sender.
